request.style: English, female solo voice with warm resonance, acoustic guitar, cello, light percussion, soft piano, hopeful and majestic mood, 84 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Come let us sing for joy to the Lord
Let us shout aloud to our rock
He is the source of our salvation
The foundation of our hope

[Chorus]
Let us come before him with thanksgiving
Shout to him with songs of praise
For the Lord is a great God
A great King above all gods

[Verse]
In his hand are the depths of the earth
And the heights of the mountains are his
The sea is his for he made it
His hands formed the dry land

[Chorus]
Let us come before him with thanksgiving
Shout to him with songs of praise
For the Lord is a great God
A great King above all gods

[Bridge]
Come let us sing for joy to the Lord
Shout aloud to the rock of our salvation

[Chorus]
Let us come before him with thanksgiving
Shout to him with songs of praise
For the Lord is a great God
A great King above all gods

[Outro]
Shout to him with songs of praise
